concerns.text: Tasks T042–T046 (Reference Frame documentation, Alfvén Mach Number calculation, schematic plot annotations) implement features (Lorentz transformations, plasma rest-frame analysis, dynamic MHD visualizations) that are explicitly outside the scope of spec.md (which limits analysis to bulk Vsw-Ey correlation in the Earth/GSM frame) and contradict the 'Scope Alignment' note in tasks.md itself. These tasks have no matching FR/SC in spec.md and represent scope creep.

Task T003 includes a malformed claim placeholder '{{claim:c_4d80c219}} (OEIS A000040, https://oeis/A000040)' in the definition of LAG_STEP or related constants. This is an invalid template artifact that will cause code generation or configuration loading to fail. No valid FR/SC maps to this malformed placeholder.

Task T009 includes a malformed claim placeholder '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_fdf659b4 — status=not_enough_info]' referencing an arXiv paper for the bootstrap method. This unresolved dependency blocks the verification of the bootstrap implementation (FR-006) and has no matching valid FR/SC to satisfy the requirement.

Tasks T021, T022, T023, T024, T025, T026, T041a, T041b, and T041c are marked as failed/rejected in the project history for lacking concrete artifacts, yet they remain listed as open tasks without a revised verification strategy. The plan must be updated to define how these specific deliverables will be generated and verified, or the tasks must be decomposed into atomic steps that produce checkable intermediate artifacts.

Task T044 (Update README) is listed as dependent on Phase 7 tasks (T042–T046) which introduce out-of-scope physics features. If T042–T046 are removed per the scope violation, the README update logic in T044 must be adjusted to remove references to 'Reference Frame' and 'Physical Mechanism' sections that will no longer exist in the final report.
